comment: The Haro v0.7 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.7 grows v0.6 by ASK -- the Q letter: the language's own closed question grammar (haro/CHARTER.md section 3's ASK row; haro/SPIKE.md, the seventh rung): FROM the kinds a question may name, WHERE the EXPRESSION a condition is written in, CLAUSES the optional clauses the question admits (where, order, limit) -- and by one word on an EXPRESSION's ABSENT: missing, zing's own reading of a reference to nothing (0 to arithmetic, the empty text to a comparison, first in an order). Every v0.6 fixture still passes: v0.7 refuses nothing v0.6 accepted. Rejects carry the fragment the refusal must contain.

accepts.name: an ASK: FROM the kinds a question names, WHERE its expression, CLAUSES the optional clauses it admits
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.7", GRAMMAR "0.7", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [or, and, cmp, contains], OPERANDS [number, text, ref], ABSENT missing, EQUALITY value) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE ASK questions AS (FROM [flow], WHERE zexpr, CLAUSES [where, order, limit]) RATIONALE "SELECT * FROM flow [WHERE expr] [ORDER BY field] [LIMIT n]"

accepts.name: an ASK with FROM alone: a question that lists, with no condition, no order and no limit
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.7", GRAMMAR "0.7", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION entity AS (VERB "ENTITY", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE ASK listing AS (FROM [flow, entity]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: ABSENT missing: a reference to nothing reads as 0 to arithmetic, the empty text to a comparison, first in an order
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.7", GRAMMAR "0.7", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [cmp, add], OPERANDS [number, ref], ABSENT missing, DIVISION calm, EQUALITY value) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a v0.6 declaration is a v0.7 declaration: v0.6's A4, unchanged
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.6", GRAMMAR "0.6", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [or, and, cmp, add, sub, mul, div, round], OPERANDS [number, text, ref, agg], AGGREGATES [sum, count], ABSENT zero, DIVISION calm, EQUALITY value) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU actors AS (WORDS [collector, treasurer, system]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION norm AS (VERB "NORM", SEATS [rule: zexpr, message: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [flow: flow, order: number, actor: actors, validate: zexpr?, enforcing: norm?, compute: name?, formula: zexpr?, on_fail: text?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WALK flows AS (OF flow, STEPS step, THROUGH flow, ORDER order, GUARDS [validate, enforcing.rule], COMPUTE compute, FORMULA formula, FAIL on_fail) RATIONALE "a record walks a flow's steps in order; a guard that fails stops it there"

rejects.name: CLAUSES is a closed menu: where, order, limit
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.7", GRAMMAR "0.7", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [cmp], OPERANDS [number, ref]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE ASK questions AS (FROM [flow], WHERE zexpr, CLAUSES [where, group]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: is not a clause a question admits
